items.name: cn
items.title: Convert UI class helper
items.description: clsx + tailwind-merge, scoped to registry items that use Tailwind utility classNames. Separate from this package's own npm-published cn().

items.name: tokens
items.title: Convert UI tokens
items.description: Editable token source, a portable generator, compiled CSS custom properties, and a bridge mapping them onto the standard shadcn CSS variable names for upstream-compatible components. No licensed font binaries.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Upstream-compatible with shadcn/ui's Button (pinned to shadcn-ui/ui commit 3ba91b1cc83e1bbe4ab35a422ff2a694849c5048, new-york-v4 style) — same variant/size names, same asChild support. Convert styling comes entirely from the tokens item's shadcn-bridge.css.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Selectable and/or removable interactive tag. A Convert pattern with no upstream shadcn equivalent — no compatibility claim.

items.name: task-filter-example
items.title: Task filter example
items.description: A small composition proving button, chip and tokens work together in one real file, not three isolated islands.

items.name: agents
items.title: Convert UI agent guidance
items.description: Scoped guidance for coding agents working in a project that has installed Convert UI components. Does not overwrite a project's own root AGENTS.md.
